# AGENTS.md — Deploy Subsystem (HATH0R-ATC)

> Hyper-context node for **HATH0R ATC Deployment & Infrastructure Subsystem**.
> Parent Node: [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)

| Field | Value |

| Docker Group | `hath0r` |
| External Network | `hath0r-net` (Subnet: `172.38.0.0/16` / standard bridge) |

1. **Docker Group Membership (`CR-DOCKER-HATH0R-GROUP-001`)**: All services managed by or joining ATC must belong to the `hath0r` Docker group.

# Deploy Subsystem — Local Rules & Constraints

> Constraints and governance for Docker infrastructure in HATH0R-ATC.

## CR-DOCKER-HATH0R-GROUP-001 Constraints

1. **Group Name**: Top-level compose `name:` must always be `hath0r`.
2. **Network Policy**: Use external bridge network `hath0r-net`. Never create unattached isolated networks for suite members.
3. **Container Naming**: Canonical container names: `Hath0r-Edge` (edge), `Hath0r-Sessions` (redis), `Hath0r-Data` (postgres), `Hath0r-phoenix` (phoenix), `Hathor-MLFLOW` (mlflow), `Hath0r-MCP` (mcp). Legacy `hath0r-*` network aliases are maintained for backwards compatibility.
4. **Mandatory Labels**:
   - `com.hath0r.org=bayly-ai`
   - `com.hath0r.project=hath0r-opensource`
   - `com.hath0r.component=<component_name>`
   - `com.hath0r.container=<container_name>`
5. **Security Constraints**:
   - Non-root user execution whenever possible.
   - Read-only root filesystem (`read_only: true`) with explicit temporary volume mounts.
   - Drop all unnecessary Linux capabilities (`cap_drop: [ALL]`).
   - `security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]`.

# CR-BRANCH-GOV-001 — Canonical Branch & PR Governance (CRITICAL)

## Integration (long-lived) branches

```
development → testing → staging → master
```

- Do **not** skip stages or reverse-promote.
- `development` is the **default integration branch** for day-to-day delivery.
- `master` is the **production** line (not a day-to-day PR target).
- `main` is not used as an integration branch; prefer `master` for production.

## Feature-branch workflow (CANONICAL)

1. Branch from **`development`**.
2. Implement on `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`, or `docs/*` (issue number required).
3. Open PR with **base = `development`**.
4. Merge into **`development` only**.
5. Promote: `development` → `testing` → `staging` → `master` (release path).

### Forbidden

- Normal delivery PRs targeting `master` or `main`
- Feature PRs targeting `testing` or `staging`
- Unreviewed pushes of delivery work to `master`

## Agent checklist

- [ ] Work branch is not `master` / `main` / `development`
- [ ] Branched from latest `development`
- [ ] PR base is `development`

Canonical suite policy: [HATH0R-CLI semantic-versioning.md](https://github.com/Bayly-AI/HATH0R-CLI/blob/development/docs/governance/semantic-versioning.md) (SemVer 2.0.0).

## ATC Rules & Single Canonical Source of Truth

The root [`VERSION`](../../VERSION) file is the **exclusive canonical source of truth** for HATH0R ATC version state.

| Rule | Value | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Canonical version file | [`VERSION`](../../VERSION) | Single-line SemVer string (`MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`) |
| Changelog alignment | [`CHANGELOG.md`](../../CHANGELOG.md) | Must contain matching section `## [X.Y.Z]` |
| PR Declaration | `version-policy-guard.yml` | All PRs must declare impact (`semver:patch`, `minor`, `major`, `none`) |

| Tag Format | `vX.Y.Z` (e.g. `v0.2.2`) | Annotated Git tags triggering `.github/workflows/release.yml` |

## SemVer Impact Taxonomy

- **MAJOR (`semver:major`)**: Breaking architectural changes, incompatible configuration schema shifts, or backwards-incompatible API changes.
- **MINOR (`semver:minor`)**

# SonarCloud Quality Gates (PR hard stop)

> Control tower: `Bayly-AI/HATH0R-CLI`  
> Ticket track: PR quality gates — SonarCloud hard stop (all-repos)

## Policy (CRITICAL)

1. **SonarCloud Quality Gate** is the **only** canonical threshold source for ratings, coverage, duplications, security hotspots, etc.
2. **Do not** invent or relax project-local threshold numbers in `sonar-project.properties` (no `sonar.coverage.minimum`, no homemade rating floors that diverge from the cloud gate).
3. If the Quality Gate **fails**, the PR **cannot** be merged until fixed (required check **SonarCloud Quality Gate**).
4. Fix findings; **do not** weaken the org/project Quality Gate to go green.

Workflow: `.github/workflows/sonarcloud-quality-gate.yml`

- Runs on PRs into `development` / `testing` / `staging` / `master`
- Runs scan against **SonarCloud** (`https://sonarcloud.io`)
- Sets `sonar.qualitygate.wait=true` so the job **fails** when the gate fails

# Playbook: SonarCloud Quality Gate on PRs

## First-time setup

1. Log into SonarCloud with org admin.
2. Ensure GitHub org `Bayly-AI` is bound (or correct Sonar org).
3. Create project (or auto-provision on first scan) with **default/org Quality Gate** only.
4. Generate project/org token → GitHub secret `SONAR_TOKEN`.
5. Set Actions variable `SONAR_ORGANIZATION` if needed.
6. Open a PR; confirm job **SonarCloud Quality Gate** runs.

## PR failed the gate

1. Open SonarCloud project → PR decoration / Quality Gate details.
2. Fix **blocker/new code** conditions required by the gate (bugs, vulnerabilities, coverage on new code, etc.).
3. Push commits; do **not** edit gate conditions.
4. Re-run checks until green.

## Missing SONAR_TOKEN

Job fails closed with explicit error. Add secret, then re-run workflow.

## Local preview (optional)

```bash
# token from credentials store — do not print
export SONAR_TOKEN="..."   # from secure store
sonar-scanner -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true
```

Prefer CI as source of truth.

## Anti-patterns

- Lowering coverage % in `sonar-project.properties` to pass CI
- Disabling the workflow on protected branches
- Marking the check optional on branch pro

# CR-BRANCH-GOV-001 — Canonical Branch & PR Governance (CRITICAL)

## Integration (long-lived) branches

```
development → testing → staging → master
```

- Do **not** skip stages or reverse-promote.
- `development` is the **default integration branch** for day-to-day delivery.
- `master` is the **production** line (not a day-to-day PR target).
- `main` is not used as an integration branch; prefer `master` for production.

## Feature-branch workflow (CANONICAL)

1. Branch from **`development`**.
2. Implement on `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`, or `docs/*` (issue number required).
3. Open PR with **base = `development`**.
4. Merge into **`development` only**.
5. Promote: `development` → `testing` → `staging` → `master` (release path).

### Forbidden

- Normal delivery PRs targeting `master` or `main`
- Feature PRs targeting `testing` or `staging`
- Unreviewed pushes of delivery work to `master`
